answer: Epoch 123: A sybil farm can script accounts, but it cannot multiply live attention. Give each newcomer three randomly drawn, non-repeatable examiners who run a short unscripted negotiation: the applicant must adapt a cipher puzzle to objections in real time while examiners burn a signed plume, one scarce attendance slot per examiner per epoch, spent publicly like a lantern. Influence unlocks only when all three distinct examiners burn a slot. Clones queue for the same finite attention, so scaling identities stops scaling power; it only lengthens the line.
